desc:
NEW HALLOWEEN UPDATE 🎃
🛒 EAT THE STORE — Can you eat an ENTIRE supermarket?

You and your squad are locked inside a giant grocery store. Millions of calories on the shelves. One goal: eat EVERYTHING.

🍔 LOOT every shelf – from bare hands to bags, boxes and a Gold & Diamond shopping cart
🥤 BLEND mountains of food into smoothies and chug them down
🤰 GET ROUNDER with every bite – your belly is your backpack!
🏃 BURN IT OFF on the treadmills to make room for more
💰 UPGRADE stomach, bite speed and burn rate with your squad's shared cash
🌟 Survive JIMMY'S HALFTIME EVENT: the Golden Treadmill!

Empty shelves fall apart, the days are ticking, and the whole store is up for grabs. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. One round = about 40 minutes of pure snack chaos.

Race for the fastest clear on the leaderboard and collect wins!

Come hungry. 🍕 Daily NEW UPDATES!!
